senses.gloss:
r. 1st and 10th cls. (बलति बलयति)
1 To live.
2 To hoard grain.
3 To prevent or obstruct wealth.
r. 1st cl. (बलते)
1 To kill.
2 To go.
r. 10th cl. (बालयते)
To explain.
(बालयति)
To support, nourish, rear, as a child.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Strong, stout, robust, powerful.
m. (-लः)
1 BALADEVA, the elder brother of KṚṢṆA, and the third of the three incarnations termed RĀMAS.
2 A crow.
3 A demon, slain by INDRA.
4 The Varuṇa tree.
n. (-लं)
1 Strength, power.
2 Bulkiness.
3 Form, figure.
4 An army, forces.
5 Gum myrrh.
6 Semen virile.
7 The body.
8 The leaf of a tree.
9 Blood.
10 Rigour, severity.
f. (-ला)
An aquatic plant, (Sida cordifolia.)
E.
बल to live, aff. अच्; in some of the senses it may be derived from वल to go or surround, and may then be written with the semivowel: see वल.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Ignorant, unwise, uninstructed.
2 Young, infantine, a child.
mf. (-लः-ला)
1 An infant, a child; it usually means the young child, under five years old, but is equally applicable till sixteen years of age.
2 A colt.
3 A five year old elephant.
4 An elephant's tail.
5 A horse's tail.
6 Any tail.
7 Hair.
8 A sort of fish, (Cyprinus Rohita, HAM.)
mn. (-लः-लं)
A perfume, perhaps a sort of fragrant grass, (Andropogon schænanthus.)
f. (-ला)
1 Small cardamoms.
2 A woman, a female.
3 Aloes.
4 Another plant, commonly Acnadhi.
5 The cocoa-nut.
6 Turmeric.
7 A sort of jasmine.
8 A flower, (Hibiscus tortuosus, Rox.)
9 Pure, (applied specially to a female animal, as a heifer, &c. fit for an oblation.)
f. (-ली)
A sort of ear-ring.
E.
बल to live, aff. घञ्, it sometimes occurs, but less accurately perhaps, with a palatial initial.

m. (-क्षः)
White, (the colour, &c.)
E.
बल strength, and क्षै to waste, aff. क; this word is more properly written वलक्ष, q. v.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Produced by or from strength or power.
n. (-जं)
1 A field.
2 A city gate.
3 Fruit.
4 War.
5 Pith, marrow.
f. (-जा)
1 A pretty or handsome woman.
2 The earth.
3 Arabian jasmine.
E.
बल strength, and ज born.

m. (-ट्)
A name of INDRA.
E.
बल, and द्विष् a foe.

m. (-वः)
1 BALADEVA, the elder brother of KṚṢṆA.
2 Air, wind.
f. (-वा)
A medicinal plant, commonly Trāyamāṇa.
E.
बल the same, and देव divine, or बल strength, and देव who sports.

m. (-हः)
Weakening, reducing strength or power.
E.
बल, and निग्रह restraint.

f. (-सूः)
ROHIṆĪ, the mother of BALARĀMA.
E.
बल, and प्रसू the mother.

m. (-द्रः)
1 BALADEVA, as above.
2 ANANTA, the great serpent, considered as identified with the preceding, BALADEVA being regarded by some authorities as an incarnation of ANANTA.
3 A strong or robust man.
4 A tree, commonly Lodh.
f. (-द्रा)
1 A young girl, a maiden.
2 A drug, commonly Trāyamāṇa.
E.
बल strength, and भद्र auspicious, excellent.

f. (-का)
A medicinal plant, Trāyamāṇa.
E.
बलभद्रा the same, and कन् aff.

mfn. (-भिद्)
Breaking or routing an army.
m. (-भिद्)
INDRA.
E.
बल, and भिद् who or what destroys.

m. (-मः)
The demigod named BALARĀMA, half brother to KṚṢṆA, and the third of the RĀMAS; according to some, the eighth Avatāra of VIṢṆU.
E.
बल strength, रम to sport, aff. घञ्.

m. (-लः)
BALARĀMA: see the last.
E.
बल strength, aff. लच्.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Strong, stout, lusty, powerful.
E.
बल strength, and मतुप् poss. aff.

f. (-ता)
Strength, power.
E.
बलवत्, and तल् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Strengthening.
2 Ennobling.
E.
बल, and वर्द्धन augmenting.

mfn. (-र्द्धी-र्द्धिनी-र्द्धि)
Strengthening.
f. (-र्द्धिनी)
A plant: see जीबक.
E.
बल, and वर्द्धिन् what augments.

m. (-सः)
Array of troops.
E.
बल forces, and विन्यास disposition.

m. (नः)
INDRA.
E.
बल, वृत्र two demons, and निसूदन destroyer.

m. (-हा)
A name of INDRA.
E.
बलवृत्र as before, हन् who kills.

n. (-नं)
Defeat or rout of an army.
E.
बल, and व्यसन calamity.

f. (-ता)
Pride of, or confidence in strength or prowess.
E.
बलशालि, and तल् added.

mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि)
Having strength, confident of strength, &c.
E.
बल, and शालिन् having.

m. (-नः)
A name of INDRA.
E.
बल the demons, and सूदन destroyer.

f. (-तिः)
A royal residence, a royal camp or quarters.
E.
बल forces, स्थिति station.

m. (-हा)
Phlegm, the phlegmatic humour.
E.
बल strength, and हन् destroying.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Weak, infirm.
E.
बल, and हीन void of.

f. (-ता)
Exhaustion, weakness, prostration of strength, infirmity from fatigue or age, &c.
E.
बलहीन, and तल् added.

f. (-का)
A sort of crane.
E.
बल strength, अक् to go, aff. अच्; it is preferably written वलाका.

m. (-कः)
1 A boy, an infant: see the last.
2 A fool, a blockhead.
3 The tail of a horse or elephant.
4 A finger ring. []
5 A bracelet.
6 A perfume; also द्रीवेर.
f. (-लिका)
1 A female infant.
2 Sand.
3 The knot or flower of an ear-ring.
4 The rustling of leaves.
5 Small cardamoms.
n. (-कं)
A sort of Hibiscus, (H. mutabilis.)
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

f. (-ता)
A sort of Vīṇā or lute, called also RĀMA'S lute.

m. (-टः)
A sort of beam, (Phaseolus mungo.)
E.
बल strength, and अट what goes or grows.

m. (-रः)
1 Violence, oppression, exaction.
2 (In law) The detention of the person of a debtor by his creditor, and the violent measures taken by the latter, (flogging, &c.) to recover his debt.
E.
बल strength, अत to go, aff. क्विप्, बलात्, and कार making, doing.

f. (-का)
A sort of sun-flower, (Heliotropium Indicum.)
E.
बल strength, आत्मन् self, aff. कन्, fem. form.

m. (-क्षः)
Commander of an army, a general.
E.
वल, and अध्यक्ष superintendant.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Strong, powerful.
2 Leading an army.
E.
बल, and अन्वित possessed of.

m. (-जः)
KṚṢṆA.
E.
बल BALARĀMA, and अनुज younger born.

ind.
By force.
E.
बल, and अपकर्ष removal.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Strong and weak.
E.
बल, and अबल feeble.

m. (-पः)
Pride of strength or prowess.
E.
बल, and अबलेप pride.

m. (-यः)
A plant, (Capparis trifoliata.)
E.
बल strength, अय to go, aff. अच्.

m. (-तिः)
A name of INDRA.
E.
बल a demon, and अराति an enemy.

m. (-कः)
The Caronda, (Carissa carandas.)
E.
बल strength, आङ् before ला to get, aff. बुन्.

m. (-शः)
The phlegmatic humour.
E.
बल strength, अश to eat or destroy, aff. अच्; also with कन् added बलाशक.

m. (-सः)
The phlegmatic humour.
E.
बल life or strength, अस to pervade, aff. अच्.

m. (-मः)
One of the Jaina saints.
E.
बल strength, असम unequalled.

n. (-हं)
Water.
E.
बल strength, आहा to quit, aff. क.

m. (-कः)
1 A mountain.
2 A cloud.
3 One of the Nāgas or infernal serpents.
4 The name of a demon.
E.
बल strength, अ the negative prefix to हा to abandon, aff.
E.
क्वुन् strength, this word is differently derived also, and preferably written वलाहक, q. v.

m. (-लिः)
1 Tax, royal revenue.
2 An oblation, a religious offering in general.
3 The handle of a Chowrie or fly-flapper.
4 Presentation of food to all created beings, one of the five great sacraments of the Hindu religion: it consists in throwing a small parcel of the offering, Ghee or rice, or the like, into the open air at the back of the house.
5 The sacrifice of an animal, or raw flesh offered to the goddess DURGĀ.
6 Fragments of food left at an oblation or a meal.
7 An animal, or one which is fit for an oblation.
8 Three folds of skin at the end of the rectum.
9 A king, and Daitya, also MAHĀBALI, the virtuous sovereign of Mahābali-pura, tricked out of the dominion he had obtained over earth and heaven, by VIṢṆU, in the Vāmana or dwarf Avatāra, and left, in consideration of his merits, the sovereignty of Pātāla, or the infernal regions.
f. (-लिः-ली)
1 A wrinkle, skin shrivelled by old age.
2 The fold of skin in stout persons, especially females, upon the upper part of the belly, or between the ensiform cartilage and the navel.
3 The ridge of a thatch.
E.
बल to live, or बध to hurt or kill, ध changed to ल, aff. इन् or इ.

m. (-लिः)
A monkey, the son of INDRA, killed by RĀMA.
E.
बाल hair, and इन् aff.; being born from the hair of his mother.

m. (-कः)
The edge of a thatch.
E.
बलि the ridge, and कन् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Offering sacrifices.
2 Producing wrinkles.
E.
बलि before कृ to make, टच् aff.

m. (-म्भः)
Sacrificial cake.
E.
बलि, and करम्भ a sort of cake.

n. (-र्म्म)
Offering of oblations to all creatures.
E.
बलि, and कर्म्मन् act.

n. (-नं)
1 Offering victims in sacrifice.
2 Giving food to all beings.
E.
बलि, and दान giving.

m. (-सी)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
बलि the king so named, and ध्वंसिन् injuring.

mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि)
Strong, stout, robust.
m. (-ली)
1 A camel.
2 A buffalo.
3 A bull.
4 A hog.
5 Phlegm.
6 A name of BALARĀMA.
7 A sort of pulse, (Phaseolus radiatus.)
8 A sort of jasmine, (J. pubescens.)
f. (-नी)
Sida cordifolia.
E.
बल strength, इनि aff.

m. (-ली)
The monkey son of INDRA.
f. (-नी)
The constellation Aśvinī.
E.
see the last, aff. इनि.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Shrivelled, wrinkled, flabby, flaccid.
E.
बलि wrinkled skin, aff. न.

m. (नः)
A scorpion.

n. (-नः)
VĀṆĀSURA, the son of BALI.
E.
बलि, and नन्दन the son; BALI had however four sons, to either of whom the epithet is applicable.

m. (-मः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
बलि, and दम to humble, खच् aff.

m. (-ष्टः)
A crow.
E.
बलि fragments of food, and पुष्ट nourished.

m. (-यः)
The Lodh tree.
E.
बलि sacrifice, and प्रिय fond of; said to grow the quicker for being perfumed and illuminated.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Shrivelled, withered, flaccid, wrinkled.
E.
बलि a wrinkle, भ aff.

m. (-भुक्)
1 A crow.
2 A sparrow.
3 A crane.
E.
बलि the orts of a meal or sacrifice, and भुज् who eats.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
Wrinkled, shrivelled, flaccid.
E.
बलि a wrinkle, and मतुप् poss. aff.

n. (-रं)
The infernal regions.
E.
बलि the Daitya, and मन्दिर abode.

m. (-खः)
A monkey.
E.
बलि a wrinkle, and मुख a face: also बलीमुख.

m. (-खः)
A monkey.
E.
बली a wrinkle, and मुख face.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Very strong, more or most powerful.
E.
बल, and इष्ठन् super. aff.

mfn. (ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु)
Arrogant, disrespectful.
E.
बल to be powerful, इष्णु Uṇādi aff.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 The lash of a whip.
2 A number of monkeys.
3 The base of an ant hill.

n. (-द्म)
The infernal regions.
E.
बलि the Daitya, sovereign of Pātāla, and मद्मन् abode.

m. (-हा)
VIṢṆU.
E.
बलि BALI, and हन् to injure, aff. क्विप्.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
Very strong, exceedingly powerful.
E.
बल strong, ईयसुन् superlative aff.

n. (-स्त्वं)
Superiority in strength.
E.
बलीयस्, and त्व added.

m. (-र्द्दः)
A bull or ox.
E.
बल strength, and वर्द्ध increasing, ली substituted for ल, and द final for ध; also वरीबर्द्द and वलीवर्द्द.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Endowed with or possessed of strength.
E.
बल, and उपविष्ट entered.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Possessed of strength.
E.
बल, and उपेत possessed of.

mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं)
Strong, vigorous.
n. (-ल्यं)
Semen virile.
m. (-ल्यः)
A Bauddha mendicant.
E.
बल strength, यत् aff.

n. (-ल्यं)
Childhood.
E.
बाल a child, ष्यञ् aff.

n. (-त्वं)
Childhood, childishness.
E.
बालक, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, बालकता.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Childish, infantine.
E.
बालक, and छ aff.

m. (-मिः)
A louse.
E.
बाल hair, and कृमि a worm.

m. (-ल्यः)
A divine personage, of the size of the thumb, sixty thousand of whom were produced from the hair of BRAHMA'S body.

f. (-णी)
A cow with calf for the first time.
E.
बाल young, गर्ब्भिणी pregnant.

m. (-र्य्यः)
KĀRTTIKEYA.
E.
बाल a child, and चर्य्य usage.

m. (-यः)
1 A young son.
2 A tree, (Mimosa catechu.)
E.
बाल young or small, and तनय offspring, leaves.

n. (-न्त्रं)
Midwifery, care of a lying-in woman, and her child.
E.
बाल an infant, and तन्त्र rule, management.

n. (-णं)
Young grass.
E.
बाल young, and तृण grass.

m. (-कः)
A tree, (Mimosa catechu.)
E.
बाल small, दल a leaf, aff. कन्.

n. (-नं)
The property of a minor or infant.
E.
बाल, and धन wealth.

m. (-धिः)
A hairy tail, as a horse's, &c.
E.
बाल hair, धा to have, कि.

m. (-त्रः)
Khayar, (Mimosa catechu.)
E.
बाल young or small, and पत्र a leaf; also with कन् added, बालपत्रक.

f. (-श्या)
1 An ornament of gold or silver, &c. worn between the hair divided on the forehead.
2 A string of pearls binding the hair.
E.
बाल hair, पाश a tie or quantity, and यत् aff.

f. (-ष्पी)
A sort of jasmine, (J. auriculatum.)
E.
बाल the hair, and पुष्प flower; worn in the hair.

m. (-कः)
A sort of mineral poison.

m. (-वः)
Childhood.
E.
बाल, and भाव nature.

f. (-का)
A small rat or mouse.
E.
बाल small, भूषिका a rat.

n. (-कं)
A sort of substitute for the sacrificial thread, a string or scarf as worn by children, (?)
E.
बाल a child, and यज्ञोपवीत the Brahminical cord.

m. (-जः)
Lapis lazuli.
E.
बाल young, and राज what shines.

m. (-त्सः)
A pigeon, a dove.
E.
बाल a child, and वत्स dear.

m. (-साः)
Woollen garments.
E.
बाल hair, (of cows, goats, &c.) and वासस् vesture.

n. (-जं)
Lapis lazuli.

m. (-ह्यः)
A wild goat.
E.
बाल hair, वह to endeavour, aff. ण्यत्.

n. (-नं)
A Chowrie, a whisk, a fly-flapper.
E.
बाल hair, and व्यजन a fan; it being made usually of the tail of the Yak.

m. (-तः)
A Bauddha saint; also named MAÑJUGHOṢA.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Of a purple colour.
m. (-भः)
Purple, the colour.
E.
बाल young, and सन्ध्या twilight, आङ् before भा to shine, aff. क.

n. (-र्य्यं)
Lapis lazuli.
E.
बाल young, सूर्य्य the sun; also with कन् added, बालसूर्य्यक n. (-कं)

m. (-स्तः)
The tail of a horse, or any hairy animal.
E.
बाल hair, and हस्त the hand, to which organ it is compared.

f. (-क्षी)
A plant, commonly Keśapuṣṭa.

m. (-पः)
The rays of the rising sun.
E.
बाल, and आतप light.

n. (-त्यं)
Young offspring or progeny.
E.
बाल, and अपत्य offspring.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
1 Young.
2 Ignorant.
3 Careless, heedless.
n. (-शं)
A pillow.
E.
बाड to emerge, इन् aff., बाडि or बालि, and शो to destroy, aff. ड.

m. (-शः)
Pain in making water from gravel, &c.

n. (-श्यं)
1 Thoughtlessness, heedlessness.
2 Youth.
3 Folly.
E.
बालिश, and यञ् aff.

m. (-वः)
Name of a celebrated monkey, the son of BALI.

m. (-न्ता)
RĀMA.
E.
बालि the monkey, and हन्तृ killer.

m. (-लुः)
A drug, commonly Elavāluka.
E.
बल to live, aff. उण्.

m. (-कः)
A drug and perfume; also Elavāluka.
f. (-का)
1 Sand, gravel.
2 (Also बालुकी) A sort of cucumber, (Cucumis utilatissimus.)
3 Camphor.
4 A sand bath.
E.
बल to live, (by its means,) उकञ् aff. or बालु as above, and कन् added.

m. (-कः)
A sort of poison.

m. (-डः)
A sort of fish, (Cheilodipterus culius and butis, HAM.)
E.
बालुका sand, and गड to scatter, aff. अच्.

f. (-का)
Sugar.
E.
बालुका sand, आत्मन् identity, कन् aff. in the fem. form.

f. (-भा)
One of the seven hells of the Jainas, the hell of sand.
E.
बालुका sand, and प्रभा splendour.

f. (-ङ्की)
A sort of cucumber, (Cucumis utilatissimus.) also बालुकी, बालुङ्गी.

f. (-ङ्गी)
A sort of cucumber: see the last; also with कन् added बालुङ्गिका.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
1 Soft.
2 Fit or proper for a child.
3 Fit or proper for a tax, a sacrifice, &c.
m. (-यः)
1 An ass.
2 A demon, a Daitya.
3 A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica.)
E.
बलि a tax, a sacrifice, or बाल a child, and ढक् aff.

m. (-कः)
A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica.)
E.
बालेय an ass, and शाक a potherb; also बालेय.

n. (-तं)
1 The sacrificial thread, or a substitute for it as worn by children.
2 A cloth covering the privities.
E.
बाल a child, उपवीत the thread.
